column2: [From.GetSheHeCap] will think twice before crossing me again.
Why complicate things when there is nothing like the good old rack? Judging by [From.GetTitledFirstName]'s screams it seems like [From.GetSheHe] learnt [From.GetHerHis] lesson...
M-me-merciful?!

You are quietly contemplating your fate when suddenly your jailor enters and drags you from your cell. "Do not worry" he assured you, with a less than reassuring smile. "You will not meet the headman's axe today. The merciful [From.GetTitle] has decided that the rack will suffice."
[From.GetSheHeCap] better watch [From.GetHerHis] back...

Oh, the sweet kiss of the whip! [From.GetTitledFirstName] will be sleeping on [From.GetHerHis] stomach for quite some time. Judging by [From.GetTitledFirstName]'s screams it seems like [From.GetSheHe] learnt [From.GetHerHis] lesson...
M-me-merciful?!

You are quietly contemplating your fate when suddenly your jailor enters and drags you from your cell. "Do not worry" he assured you, with a less than reassuring smile. "You will not meet the headman's axe today. The merciful [From.GetTitle] has decided that the whip will suffice."
[From.GetSheHeCap] should be grateful to be alive...

A bucket of rats was strapped to [From.GetTitledFirstName]'s chest and heated with burning coals. Fortunately, it was removed before the rats managed to gnaw a way through [From.GetHerHim]. Judging by [From.GetTitledFirstName]'s screams it seems like [From.GetSheHe] learnt [From.GetHerHis] lesson...
Wha-what...?!

You are quietly contemplating your fate in your lonely cell when suddenly your jailor enters. "A proper introduction to your cell mates is due" he says and drags you with him. "The rats. While they might appear withdrawn at first, I'm certain you will think them forward enough when they gnaw through your chest."
Tickle [From.GetHerHim]! Tickle [From.GetHerHim] until [From.GetSheHe] screams of laughter!
For [From.GetHerHis] heinous crime, that [GetRootFromInsult] [From.GetTitledFirstName] deserves nothing but the most excruciating punishment. [From.GetSheHeCap] will be tortured... with a feather.
Alright...

You are quietly contemplating your fate when suddenly your jailor enters. You struggle to decipher the look on his face, but you think he might be... disappointed. You demand to know what is going on. "Our almighty [From.GetTitle] has ordered you to be tortured... with a feather."
A sufficient punishment.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] was undressed, tied to a pole and left out in the heat for a few days. While it seems like [From.GetSheHe] suffered no permanent damage, [From.GetSheHe] had to be carried back inside. You are sure [From.GetSheHe] learnt [From.GetHerHis] lesson...
Y-you must be kidding...? S-surely?

You are quietly contemplating your fate when suddenly your jailor enters. "Remove your clothes" he demands with an ominous grin. "Do not worry, no one will stare at you. You will be quite alone. In the wilderness. Tied to a pole."
At least [From.GetSheHe] lives to tell the tale.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] was undressed, tied to a pole and left out in the snow overnight. While it seems like [From.GetSheHe] suffered no permanent damage, [From.GetSheHe] had to be carried back inside. You are sure [From.GetSheHe] learnt [From.GetHerHis] lesson...
Y-you must be kidding...? S-surely?

You are quietly contemplating your fate when suddenly your jailor enters. "Remove your clothes" he demands with an ominous grin. "Do not worry, no one will stare at you. You will be quite alone. In the wilderness. Tied to a pole."
I have not come for your head. Your leg will do just fine.

You order the jailor to drag [From.GetTitledFirstName] from [From.GetHerHis] cell while you methodically prepare your tools. No one crosses you unscathed and [From.GetFirstName] will become a living example of this. At least that's the plan, but who knows? You could... slip.
M-my... my leg? Please! No! NOOO!!!

You are quietly contemplating your fate when suddenly the jailor enters and drags you out of your cell. Outside, [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] awaits. Your blood runs cold when you see [FromFrom.GetHerHis] cold grin. "Do not worry, you [GetFromFromRootInsult]. I have not come for your head. Your leg will do just fine."
I have not come for your head. Your hand will do just fine.

Your blood runs cold when you see [FromFrom.GetHerHis] cold grin. "Do not worry, you [GetFromFromRootInsult]. I have not come for your head. Your manhood will do just fine."
[From.GetHerHisCap] ears will ring with contemptible cadence for weeks!

[From.GetTitledFirstName] is forced to spend a full hour listening to one of your guards reciting your most atrocious poetry. Not only is the brute butchering the rhythm of it, but you made certain this particular poem contains the most contrived metaphors.
This is incredibly awkward.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has sentenced you to one of [From.GetHerHis] infamous poetry readings. For over an hour you squirm as a brutish guard completely misunderstands the intonation of each phrase, and you find yourself wincing at each superfluous adjective.
[From.GetHerHisCap] delicate intellect will be tarnished forever.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] is forced to spend a full hour listening to a child reciting some of your most repellent poetry. Not only is the young imbecile void of rhetoric skill, but you made certain this poem is particularly trite.
This is deplorable.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has sentenced you to one of [From.GetHerHis] notorious poetry readings. A child is presented to you, to declaim the most abominable mush of sunset related laments. You have never heard anything quite so vapid.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] cringed the whole thing through!

[From.GetTitledFirstName] is forced to spend a full hour listening to one of the [Root.Religion.GetPriestTitle]s reciting some of your raunchiest poems. Not only is the holy person hesitantly mumbling out the words, but their face is reddening with each phrase. The scene is very uncomfortable.
My mind is tarnished forever.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has sentenced you to one of [From.GetHerHis] disreputable poetry readings. The bawdy poem, and the banality of life it implied, will stay with you for a long time...

You order tar be poured over [From.GetTitledFirstName], after which [From.GetSheHe] is rolled in feathers. Your guards laugh as they wheel [From.GetHerHim] around the city. Commoners and nobles alike sneer incredulously at [From.GetTitledFirstName]. What a display!
The dress suits [From.GetHerHim].

Your [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] has decided to be merciful and you are safe from the rack. However, before your release you are to be drenched in tar and rolled in feathers. You will then be put on a cart and wheeled through the streets. The guard escorting you to your sentence snickers delightedly at your predicament.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has decided to be merciful and I am safe from the rack. However, [From.GetSheHe] has ordered that I am to be drenched in tar and rolled in feathers! I will then be put on a cart and wheeled through the streets...! The guard escorting me to my sentence snickers delightedly my predicament.
I do not deserve this humiliation!
After some struggle [From.GetTitledFirstName] is dragged from [From.GetHerHis] cell, out to the town square and put in the stocks. [From.GetSheHeCap] will learn to respect you soon enough.
Let them stare! Serves [From.GetHerHim] right.

The guards rouse you from your slumber and you are dragged from your cell. Your [From.GetTitledFirstName] has decided to release you, but not before you have spent some time in the stocks. "Discourages the youth from causing trouble", one guard mumbles. "Oh, and expect rotten turnips."

The guards rouse me from my slumber and I am dragged from my cell. [From.GetTitledFirstName] has decided to have me spend some time in the stocks. "Discourages the youth from causing trouble", a guard mumbles. "Oh, and expect rotten turnips."
This is so embarrassing!

The scurrilous [From.GetTitledFirstName] is bound by the hands and led through the crowded streets, dressed in naught but [From.GetHerHis] shame. May your people and the heavens bear witness to [From.GetHerHis] repentance!
I did it for [From.GetHerHis] own good.

Your [From.GetTitledFirstName] has sentenced you. To repent for your unsavory crimes, you are to be led through the crowded streets, naked in front of the people as well as the heavens. Shame is your name.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has decided that to begin repenting for my unsavory crimes, I am to be led through the crowded streets, naked, in front of the people as well as the heavens. "Shame is your name!" a brutish guard yells at me, before dragging me out of my cell.
My name is [Root.GetTitledFirstName]! This is unfair!

You order [From.GetTitledFirstName] be stripped of [From.GetHerHis] clothing, [From.GetHerHis] hands and feet bound, before [From.GetSheHe] is slung up on horseback. The [GetRootFromInsult] will be paraded around your camp: let all bear witness to [From.GetHerHis] humiliation!
That's entertainment!

What seems like an ordinary day in your confinement takes a brusque turn when guards appear to strip you of your clothing. [From.GetTitledFirstName] has sentenced you to be tied up and paraded around camp on horseback. "You'll be nude, but you'll live", a guards spits, disappointment in his voice.
How will I ever face anyone again?
Disappointing but understandable...
My [GetFromRelation], [From.GetTitledFirstName], has been released from prison by the perfidious [FromFrom.GetBestName] in return for [From.GetPossPronoun] services.
Your prisoner has been blinded and released. The fool should have known better than to look at you with scornful eyes.
Watch your step.
[Root.GetTitledFirstName] is blinded.

Your jailers enter your cell grinning from ear to ear, something experience has taught you is a very bad sign. 'Good news!' one of them says cheerfully. 'New orders from the [From.GetTitle]. Ye are to be set free... after ye have been blinded. Take a good look at this cell, because it is the last thing ye shall ever lay eyes on!'
S-stay away from me!
Your prisoner has been castrated and released. His screams could be heard all the way to your chambers.
He had it coming.
[Root.GetTitledFirstName] is castrated.

The commotion outside your cell wakes you suddenly and you demand to know what is going on. Your jailers enter with an old, toothless barber-surgeon carrying a satchel of instruments. 'The [From.GetTitle], in [From.GetHerHis] infinite mercy, has ordered your release,' one of the guards says. 'After your castration is complete.'
No! NO!!! NOOOOOO!!!!!
You have the boy castrated and made a eunuch. You are a real piece of work, aren't you?
These are violent times.
The cell is cold, the straw is rotten and the rats have stopped being afraid of me. I am a [Root.GetTitle], not a cutpurse. Perhaps my jailer could be persuaded to remember it.
Send word that I ask for better quarters.
I will not beg. I deserve this.
My prisoner [From.GetTitledFirstName] asks to be moved out of the dungeon into more fitting quarters.
The dungeon is fitting enough.
Very well, house arrest.
Fitting quarters? Throw [From.GetHerHim] in the oubliette!
[From.GetSheHeCap] is no longer my prisoner.
Let [From.GetHerHim] go, and remember who did it.
The guards have moved me to a room with a window, a bed and a door that is merely locked. It is still a prison, but I can see the sky.
Much better.
The guards came at night and dragged me down past the dungeon, down a ladder into a hole in the rock barely wide enough to sit in. The lid closed above me. It is completely dark.
[Root.Religion.GetHighGodName], have mercy...
The cell door stands open. [From.GetTitledFirstName] has let me go, and made it very clear that I owe [From.GetHerHim] for it.
Free!

I hear them down there at night, my prisoners, whispering in their cells. Plotting, perhaps. Laughing at me, perhaps. It would be so easy to go down with a lantern and a few willing guards and find out what they have to say for themselves.
No. I will not give in to it.
Oil the rack!
The Brazen Bull of Zharr-Naggrund hungers.
The prisoner is tortured.
The prisoner is wounded on the rack.
The prisoner's hand is crushed.
The prisoner dies.
They came for me with lanterns and took me to the room with the rack. [From.GetTitledFirstName] watched the whole time. I told them everything I knew and a great deal I did not.
Make it stop...
They stretched me on the rack until something in my shoulder gave way with a sound I will hear for the rest of my life.
Aaargh!
They put my hand in the vice and turned the screw while [From.GetTitledFirstName] asked me questions. I do not remember the questions. I remember the bones.
My hand!
The torturers went too far. My heart is giving out on the rack, and the last thing I see is [From.GetTitledFirstName] looking bored.
My prisoner [From.GetTitledFirstName] has died on the rack. The torturers apologise for their enthusiasm.
A pity. [From.GetSheHeCap] still had things to tell me.
[captured_commander.GetBestName] was taken in battle and is now my prisoner!
Perfect!
My rival, no less? Excellent!
[captured_commander.GetSheHeCap] will make a fine sacrifice to [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName]!
You have [captured_commander.GetTitledFirstName] offered up to the gods in exchange for their favour.\n

That bloodthirsty savage! [From.GetTitledFirstName] took one look at me and had me dragged from my cell to the altar. The soldiers are chanting, the priests are sharpening their knives, and nobody is listening to a word I say.
I cannot believe this is how it ends.
No...! We are brothers of [Root.Society.GetName]! Why?

My friend [petition_prisoner.GetTitledFirstName] has been rotting in [Root.Liege.GetTitledFirstName]'s dungeon for far too long. I could speak up for [petition_prisoner.GetHerHim] at court, though my liege may not thank me for it.
I will ask for [petition_prisoner.GetHerHis] release.
It is not my place.
Your liege will answer the petition.
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has come before the court to petition for the release of [petition_prisoner.GetTitledFirstName], who sits in my dungeon. The other vassals are watching to see what I do.
Very well. Release [petition_prisoner.GetHerHim].
[petition_prisoner.GetSheHeCap] stays where [petition_prisoner.GetSheHe] is.

The Maw is hungry, and [From.GetTitledFirstName] is meat like any other. You lift the screaming thing in both hands and bite, and keep biting, while the court watches in silence and the gutplates rattle. When you are done only a few polished bones are left on the table.

Da puny [From.GetFirstName] squeals all da way down. You crunch, you chew, you spit out da bits wiv armour on. Da boyz cheer and da gits in da back go green. When you're done only a few polished bones are left.
BLUURP.
